TRANSIENT.name: Transient Gateway & Network Errors
TRANSIENT.description: Temporary glitches, network timeouts, or intermediary bank server downtime. Safe to retry automatically.

codes.reason: Payment request timed out at gateway level
Gateway encountered an internal error during processing
Debit request to issuing bank timed out or failed temporarily

SOFT_DECLINE.name: Soft Declines & Balance Limits
SOFT_DECLINE.description: Insufficient customer balance or daily velocity limits. Balance will replenish (e.g. salary window, next day).

codes.reason: Customer account does not have sufficient balance
Customer has exceeded their single/daily UPI or card transaction limit
Bank account daily withdrawal ceiling reached

AUTHENTICATION_FAILURE.name: Authentication & Drop-off Failures
AUTHENTICATION_FAILURE.description: OTP expired, 3D-Secure drop-off, or customer cancellation. High friction; customer needs an alternate payment link.

codes.reason: 3D Secure OTP verification failed or timed out
Customer intentionally cancelled or abandoned the checkout modal
OTP expired before customer entered it
Customer entered incorrect OTP maximum allowed times

HARD_DECLINE.name: Hard Declines & Security Blocks
HARD_DECLINE.description: Invalid card numbers, lost/stolen card blocks, or bank fraud blocks. DO NOT RETRY without customer providing new method.

codes.reason: Card number or expiry date is invalid
Card has been reported lost, stolen, or blocked by issuer
Issuing bank fraud detection flagged and rejected the transaction

MANDATE_FAILURE.name: Recurring Mandate / Autopay Failures
MANDATE_FAILURE.description: UPI Autopay, e-NACH, or card recurring mandate execution failed. Can be sequenced with pre-debit notifications.

codes.reason: Recurring mandate execution failed on scheduled date
Customer bank did not acknowledge the mandate presentation
Customer bank account is inactive or frozen for autopay
